title: VTA PCS — Voter Register — payload
description: A voter's client asks its VTA for the blinded request that obtains the voter's ticket for one election; the VTA derives a voter key for that election alone and keeps the blinding state.

contextId.description: The context the voter belongs to. The election's voter key is derived from a path allocated under this context's base.

community.description: The community's DID: the registrar that issues the ticket. MUST equal the manifest's `community`.

parameters.description: The community's published voting parameters, copied verbatim from where the community publishes them.

manifest.description: The election's manifest, exactly as the community published it. The engine computes its digest itself.

member.description: The DID the election's roll admits the voter as — their membership DID at the community. When given, the engine also returns `ticketDocument`: the request to the community, signed as this DID. It MUST be a DID the engine holds an authentication key of that the caller may act as.

PcsValue.title: PcsValue
PcsValue.description: A suite value, multibase base58btc over its canonical (compressed) encoding.

TicketRequest.title: TicketRequest
TicketRequest.description: The `request` member of a vtc/elections/tickets/issue/0.1 request payload: the blinded root request for the election's ticket class.

request.description: The blinded root request, as the suite serialises it — the same shape as a vtc/vetting/vetters/pcs-root/0.1 request.

proof.description: The proof that the commitment is well formed and the requester holds its secret.

Response.title: VTA PCS — Voter Register — response payload
Response.description: Exactly the vtc/elections/tickets/issue/0.1 request payload, without its ext — and, when the request named `member`, that request as a document signed as the member.

manifestDigest.description: The SHA-256 multihash of the manifest's RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization, as the engine computed it.

TicketDocument.title: TicketDocument
TicketDocument.description: A complete, signed vtc/elections/tickets/issue/0.1 request document, ready to send to the community unchanged. Its payload is validated by that specification's schema; the members fixed here are the ones this task guarantees.

payload.description: The vtc/elections/tickets/issue/0.1 request payload: `electionId`, `manifestDigest` and `request`, exactly as this response carries them.

proof.description: A Data Integrity proof by an `authentication` key of `issuer`.
